scope: New own four-line time-triggered reference receiver. Not native/private HUSH, arbitrary-data coherence, hardware, application or performance validation.
fixed_epoch: Controller p,r,F and timer K,P,phi stay constant per run. Absolute integer t is the physical clock; p,r,F all start at residue 0. Four fixed distinct line tags are initially valid, bytes zero, timers disabled. No refill, revocation, unrelated invalidation, memory request, reset, clock/configuration change or source callback dependency occurs within a run. Request IDs increase globally and are never reused while live. Four independent lines may have multiple outstanding IDs.
tick_order: Snapshot entry R0 occupancy; clear tick event flags.
For each asserted WU whose line tag is currently valid, update that tag byte and enable/count=K. WU on invalid tags is ignored.
If t mod P=phi, decrement every enabled counter AFTER WU. At zero mark tag invalid, disable timer. This precedes same-tick capture.
At each release offset t mod F, enqueue owner plus fresh global request ID to FIFO8. Enqueue precedes a same-tick grant; overflow is a preserved fault.

At t mod p=0 grant head iff R0 was empty at tick entry. Attempt on invalid tag records first miss and terminates claimed equivalence. Successful capture reads current byte into immutable owner/ID/byte R0, dequeues FIFO and cancels that line timer after expiry/read ordering.
At EVERY tick, emit OLD R1 iff t mod r in {1,2}; otherwise retain all R1 snapshot fields and record backpressure.

After emission transfer R0 to R1 iff R1 is empty. A new capture may transfer immediately; a newly transferred R1 cannot emit in that tick. Entry-R0 grant guard remains effective even if an old R0 transfers now.
Emission callback is last, retiring exactly its emitted owner/ID. It does not enqueue or alter the calendar. Check bounded ownership and conservation. Advance tick/phases.
first_miss: Retain first miss tick/owner/ID. No post-miss control-equivalence, losslessness or infinite-safety claim; final failing tick can contain preceding WU/decrement/enqueue/attempt but no later emit/transfer/callback.
control_execution: Actual Yosys synthesis, generated CXXRTL, compiled C++ model; initially no WUs. Execute exactly [0,3F) for each controller. Preserve tick records and actual IDs. Compare complete control states at 0,F,2F,3F after quotienting dead fields and translating IDs by 8/frame; verify all tick event translations. If frame boundary is not empty, preserve case and mark certificate construction unknown/not applicable, without replacement.
relation: For each successful grant s, c is its matching callback and h is next same-line grant. No WU before each line's actual first capture cutpoint. Extract same-line (s,c,h) from executed grants/callbacks, including both crossing edges into next frame and checks against third frame. Cycle relation uses s in [F,2F), cycle_entry=F, repeat=2F, d=F. Prefix uses s in [first_capture,F), same actual trace. Keep every c>h case and mark completion comparator not applicable. If no frame clears, no translated empty-state policy execution is admitted.
fresh_physical_prefix: For EVERY physical P and phi recompute literal prefix expiry minima over each line's actual prefix triples; do not inherit any prior positive bit. Cycle lift consists of each cycle edge plus nF for n=0..P/gcd(P,F)-1. Both routes take the same global minimum of the fresh exact prefix. Record both cycle entry and physical lifted repetition, and all prefix triples.

grid.common_policy: One K,P,phi for all four lines
grid.expansion_reason: Pre-generation parent amendment: max frame 56p exceeds K<=5,P<=4p maximum retention 20p; expansion fixed before results.

arithmetic: For arm u=s+1, first expiry E=u+((phi-u) mod P)+(K-1)P. Strict service admission is min(E-h)>0, prefix and lifted cycle jointly, all lines. Per-line C=actual cycle callback residues modulo F; tight integer nonnegative J=max(c-s), A=max(h-c) if c<=h. Completion recurrent base=1-J-A+min_c ((phi+J-1-c) mod gcd(P,F)), plus (K-1)P. Completion route shares exact prefix. Save all admissions, failures, every optimum tie and deterministic K,P,phi selection. Objective is min KP-1 among strictly admitted policies, an explicit retention proxy only. Empty optima/no-gain remain.
one_WU_RTL: Run EVERY grid policy on its earliest minimizing actual service edge across all lines, with tie key (slack,s,line,c,h). A prefix witness uses initial t=0. A recurrent witness at s=s0+nF may start at translated empty cycle entry T=(1+n)F with all tags valid/timers disabled and byte zero; cfgstart initializes actual t and every phase to T modulo corresponding period, IDs start0 but are translated explicitly. Empty control/frame recurrence plus no earlier WU yields identical live state to all-hit prehistory; prehistory is NOT counted as executed. Execute every tick [T,h], arm target at s+1 only, predict first failure h iff slack<=0. Record T, n, physical phase, local cutpoints, WU, expiry, first miss, actual ticks, snapshot and ownership counters. Universal WU claim requires the separate first-failure/rearm proof, not finite exhaustion.

data_RTL.WUs: Each tick strictly after that line's actual initial capture; all four lines thereafter. Execute [0,3F), capture after WU/decrement, cancellation after capture. Check actual capture/emission owner+ID+byte, frozen snapshot retention, backpressure, every tick order and conservation.

proof_gate: Establish new bounded calendar-component first-failure composition argument or withhold. Old Theorem5 is not automatically a proof for this component or native/full coherence. Independent fresh synthesis/compilation/execution, independent transition/arithmetic checks and meaningful actually compiled mutants required before paper/publication use.
evidence: Number build attempts and preserve source/input/build/simulation failures and corrections. Bind protocol/source/input/tool hashes; portable replay; schema; lossless compressed full control/data and policy traces; all counters; producer checker. No remote, push, publication, private overlay or frozen manuscript edits. No elapsed-time performance result.
